name: geet
description: IntelliJ-grade Git integration for VS Code: changelists, log graph, interactive rebase, 3-pane merge, shelve, and local history.

webview/context.when: webviewId == 'geet.commit' && webviewSection == 'commitFile' && geet.paradigm == staging && stagingSide == staged
webviewId == 'geet.commit' && webviewSection == 'commitFolder' && geet.paradigm == staging && stagingSide == staged
webviewId == 'geet.commit' && webviewSection == 'commitGroup' && geet.paradigm == staging && stagingSide == staged
webviewId == 'geet.commit' && webviewSection == 'commitRepo' && geet.paradigm == staging && stagingSide == staged

editor/context.when: isInDiffEditor && resourceScheme == geet-rev && resource =~ /%22ref%22%3A%22%3A0%22/ && geet.paradigm == staging

media.altText: The Commit tool window: Commit and Shelf tabs, folder tree with tri-state checkboxes, message editor
The commit tool window with pre-commit checks
The commit graph with filter chips
Blame annotations with an age heat-map

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build && npm run build:webviews
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.pretest:integration: node esbuild.mjs && npm run build:webviews && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json
scripts.pretest:perf: node esbuild.mjs && npm run build:webviews && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json
